BLOCKED: C1a stopped on a compiler defect, so nothing was committed. Report at /home/user/Nikaia/docs/briefs/c1a-ledger-items.md.report.md

- **The defect:** the compiler emits a bare `String` passed to a `String?` parameter as `&target`, without `Some(..)`. It happens when that parameter is lowered as `&Option<String>`, which is what `declared_function`'s `target` is. Rust then refuses it with "expected `&Option<String>`, found `&String`". `docs/builder-facts.md` lists this form as working.
- **Probe:** /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Nikaia/a3f03829-e433-4ce7-a5a6-7d951a81c1b5/scratchpad/c1a/probe-option-arg.nika fails under `nikaia run` with "Mismatched types". If the body reads `(target ?? "").len()` instead of `target?.len() ?? 0`, it runs.
- **Where I suspect it:** the code that decides when an argument gets wrapped in `Some(..)`, around `emit_core_args.nika` :404-440 and `FactWrap::Constructor` in `emit_exprs.nika`. Fixing it means editing files outside the ones the brief allows, so I stopped.
- **The finished step 1 work is saved, not committed:** /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Nikaia/a3f03829-e433-4ce7-a5a6-7d951a81c1b5/scratchpad/c1a/c1a-wip.patch. It holds the four new items in `ledger_items.nika` and the `pub` in `check_attributes.nika`. It passed `lower-std` with no refusals; only the Rust compile of the generated code failed, on the defect above. A rerun after the fix can start from it.
- **Shared checkout:** I restored my two files and re-lowered them, so they match HEAD again.
- **Another agent's change:** someone rebuilt `target/fast/nikaia` at 18:40 with an emitter change to `TrustedMap`. My last `lower-std` ran on that binary and rewrote `lowered/project_members.rs` (`HashMap` to `TrustedMap`). That change is theirs, so I left it in place; whoever owns it should commit it or re-lower.
